reference.description: The benchmark is a vertical medical-animation short about simple squamous epithelium, photoreal macro 3D. Cells: irregular, wavy, interlocking outlines like jigsaw pieces, separated by narrow grooves; softly domed tops; each nucleus a raised, finely textured mauve dome near the cell centre; pale pink-beige cytoplasm with faint darker speckles. Surfaces have a soft wet sheen and subsurface translucency: light passes into the cells, and in a cutaway the side walls look glassy with the nuclei visible through them. Background: deep navy-black with faint floating dust motes. Shallow depth of field: the focus cell sharp, the foreground and the far edge softly blurred. Soft warm key light with a cool blue rim. In the exchange shot, clusters of glossy blue spheres float above the layer and pass through it. A side view shows the thin single layer on a basement membrane, with blue rod-shaped structures in the connective tissue below. Captions are large Hindi-English text in a yellow script font over the picture (captions are not part of the look to judge).
